checks.name: CK_History_Old
checks.definition: ([OldStatus] IS NULL OR ([OldStatus]=N'Cancelled' OR [OldStatus]=N'Delivered' OR [OldStatus]=N'InTransit' OR [OldStatus]=N'Confirmed' OR [OldStatus]=N'New'))

checks.name: CK_Users_Client
checks.definition: ([Role]='client' AND [ClientID] IS NOT NULL OR [Role]='admin' AND [ClientID] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_Cities_Coordinates
checks.definition: ([Latitude] IS NULL AND [Longitude] IS NULL OR [Latitude]>=(-90) AND [Latitude]<=(90) AND ([Longitude]>=(-180) AND [Longitude]<=(180)) AND [Latitude] IS NOT NULL AND [Longitude] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_Notifications_Status
checks.definition: ([NewStatus] IS NULL OR ([NewStatus]='Cancelled' OR [NewStatus]='Delivered' OR [NewStatus]='InTransit' OR [NewStatus]='Confirmed' OR [NewStatus]='New'))

checks.name: CK_Orders_PickupWindow
checks.definition: ([PickupWindowStart] IS NULL AND [PickupWindowEnd] IS NULL OR [PickupWindowStart] IS NOT NULL AND [PickupWindowEnd] IS NOT NULL AND [PickupWindowEnd]>[PickupWindowStart])
